science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: Kaio carefully studied the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea, noting the erratic visual flux. He sought to DEFEND the delicate containment grid, working to ATTRACT stray magnetic currents while watching the systems CONSUME their remaining energy. The air was filled with a low mechanical whine, the scent of ozone, a sharp metallic tang, and a cold vibration against his fingers. He handed the baton to Ryn, hoping her culinary precision could translate to thermodynamic stability.
